Recipe.Title: SnackerdoodlesSnicker, Snicker &snicker;
Recipe.Source: Based on a recipe from the website modernhoney.com
Recipe.Description: Snickerdoodles are a cookie that you roll in cinnamon-sugar just before baking. We call them "Snackerdoodles" because they are a great snack. (Which frequently triggers some snickering.)

section.prep: In a large mixing bowl, cream butter and sugar for 4-5 minutes until light and fluffy.
Scrape the sides of the bowl and add the eggs and vanilla, then cream for 1-2 minutes longer.
Add Flour, Cream of Tartar, Baking Soda, and Salt, and stir just until combined.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, stir together Sugar and Cinnamon.

section.instruction: Remove dough from plastic wrap and roll it out ≈1-1½&inches; thick.
Cut the rolled dough into ≈1-1½&inches; squares.

For each cube:
Roll it by hand into a smooth, round ball.
Drop the ball into the cinnamon-sugar mixture.
Using a spoon, roll and stir it around until it is well coated.
Place on a parchment paper-lined cookie sheet ≈2-3&inches; apart.
Let cool for 3-5 minutes on baking sheet before removing from the pan.

Notes.note: The parchment paper can be reused several times when making large batches.

Modifications.modification: For less "tang", use only 1 teaspoon of Cream of Tartar.
To make flatter Snickerdoodles, after placing the ball of dough on the cookie sheet, press down in its center. This helps to keep them from puffing up in the middle.
